newsitem.title: USA: Acordia Q4 net rises as revenue climbs.
newsitem.headline: Acordia Q4 net rises as revenue climbs.

text.p: Acordia Inc on Thursday said growth in its health-related operations and brokerage business helped boost its fourth-quarter earnings.

The company said net income in the three months ended December 31 rose to $8.9 million, or $0.64 a share, from $7.4 million, or $0.52, in the year-earlier period. The latest figure includes a gain of $799,000 related to an asset sale.
Revenue climbed to $171 million from $151.9 million.
Acordia also said it would review changes in the health-care industry in 1997 and the potential impact on its relationship with Anthem Insurance Cos Inc, its majority stockholder.
Acordia is the seventh-largest U.S. insurance brokerage firm.
